import math
import re
from datetime import datetime
import polars as pl

NULL_VALUES = {"", "n/a", "na", "-", "null", "none", "nan"}

def _clean_str(col: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.when(col.str.to_lowercase().is_in(list(NULL_VALUES))).then(None).otherwise(col)

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        device_id=_clean_str(pl.col("device")).str.to_uppercase(),
        read_at=_clean_str(pl.col("ts"))
        .cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
        .cast(pl.Datetime("us"), strict=False),
        temperature_c=_clean_str(pl.col("temp"))
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        humidity_pct=_clean_str(pl.col("rh"))
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        battery_v=_clean_str(pl.col("bat"))
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
    )
